Skeptical of large GDP gains. Only modest share of tasks automatable. But what gains exist concentrate with capital owners without active policy.

## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 2 | The gains that do appear flow to capital owners, while affected workers' wages stall. |
| Affordable essentials | 3 | Modest GDP gains bring no fall in the cost of essentials. |
| Reliable safety net | 3 | Limited automation keeps disruption within existing capacity. |
| Responsive government | 3 | Active policy is needed but feasible. |
| Time for what matters | 3 | No particular change to time for what matters. |
